meta.title: Edit Evaluation Time is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid

plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time available on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ event on the buyer side.
Navigate to the RFQ stage whose Settings menu is being tested.
Assert that Edit Evaluation Time is present and clickable in the RFQ Settings menu.
Choose the enabled menu item to open its evaluation-time window.
Assert that the Edit Evaluation Time window opens before confirmation.
Cancel the dialog so the event remains unchanged.
Assert that the evaluation-time window closed without saving changes.
